summary:
Independent frozen-design review APPROVE; no critical/high/medium findings. Actual reviewer /root/node_ci_design authored neither this installed-mutation production prototype, frozen successor specification nor its four installed companion test files. Reviewed TASK-0135 frozen spec a3d3c780ee7830eaa567235871a4657c1f70b6835da8d70ca63032a931b2b509, actual current design context1c77e54bbb2738bc3ba8e81c3e49cb332cafa1f9361843757ae222d48c63ff5e, REVIEW/V2 classification9bd438fc46bf7e868e6cdcf2760cb5af882394bed039f5a56c123fea06b12912 under unchanged Policy fac8afbe8e1f671338eadc02697a66a3c6aa9ca5494eb25ea97b80812bce4727, complete updated design and relevant native helpers and preserved prototype Git blobs. This is design approval only; no test, installed pair, native mutation, verify, approval or review-record command was executed.

Independently verified current HEAD/base23904c4c049a870ccd55a0fa2c4f42acdcf6c9f8 has no src/aiflow delta from delivered main243ee865 and neither installed production module exists. Initial design and four companion tests are genuinely separate task-free baseline commits. Importing the preserved prototype by normal merge will therefore retain the entire new production diff, rather than hide its lines in the base. TASK-0134 remains BLOCKED with its frozen history and real counterexample; the inspected event history records no actual installed pair/action launch. Prototype code and earlier local results are not successor authority or passing acceptance.

AGENTS AI Flow rule8 separates safe authoring units from governance-task authority and keeps the most severe routing and all approvals. The frozen successor satisfies that separation: initial safe assets are already independently committed in its pre-source baseline; the four exact test paths and exact design path are bounded transport only for independently task-free maintenance commits, not ownership or approval to author safe changes as part of this source task. Separate commits and authority remain mandatory, paths cannot expand under this approval, and all imported changes are still reviewed against actual base/subject. This does not reduce REVIEW/V2, any approval, the full production diff denominator,85percent total/90percent diff thresholds or required CI. There is no need to create a new ledger task merely to transport independently task-free commits. If later work actually mixes safe authoring under this source approval or changes its frozen scope, it must be separated/reclassified under existing rules; the word transport is not an exception to those rules.

The four-step closed boundary addresses the original missing-current-root counterexample. Stable InstalledMutationInputs binds exact task/base/subject/tree/spec/Policy/classification, actual role labels/context and complete installed material/probe/protocol/operator closure, while mutable HEAD/index/events/approval/root metadata are separately collected as current authority so normal approval does not invalidate itself. InstalledMutationCurrent binds the exact ref/size/SHA and complete canonical root snapshot plus sorted unique collector-verified physical Git paths. Preparation/record require current IMPLEMENTING native V2 and the new namespace-specific reviewed single-use action; collection is state-neutral and cannot borrow that execution gate or manufacture VERIFYING. Pure replay rejects cross-run Current reuse and rehashed shortened snapshots against complete live-authority inventories. Typed historical validation must precede Git arguments; ancestry and old-to-current/cached governance diffs precede physical Git allowances. Immutable review originals, exact approval/event prefixes, strict same-verifier verification_started progression and pure root metadata comparison protect legitimate evolution without broad Git/task/log exemptions. The trusted collector precondition is explicit; dataclass construction or evidence deserialization cannot grant authority. Pure replay itself performs no subprocess, recovery, mkdir, repair or writes.

The material/execution design remains feasible in the two scoped modules by reusing current inventory/copy/budget/receipt helpers, action normalization/approval matching and consumption lock, Windows suspended Job process execution and four compatible native operators. The installed001 variant has a concrete unique comparison in current policy._validate_cross_file and preserves complete-policy positive control while admitting only the missing-targeted alternative under mutation. Native declarations/operators are not generalized or changed. Require parent bytecode disabled from startup before package imports; children retain-I-S-B and fresh empty pycache_prefix, exact copied-site origins, module-name-to-legitimate-file mapping, bound actual guard references and interpreter/debug identity. Empty stderr, complete fixed phases/cases, exact designated call AssertionError/traceback/observations, receipts/EOF/Job cleanup and actual material bytes distinguish killed from unrelated exit1. The supported trusted interpreter/stdlib/loader/OS and same-user limits remain explicit rather than claimed hermeticity.

Required acceptance covers source-tree-free direct wheel and sdist/rebuilt wheel inclusion, five actual baseline/mutant pairs and independent original replay, state-neutral governance transitions, canonical/ref/root/file/metadata/input/action/material drift, module-name/path substitution, nonempty stderr, malformed/duplicate/incomplete reports, survived/unrelated failures, interrupted/concurrent single-use claims and zero-process/zero-write replay. Portable Git/action/file/parser tests must preserve Ubuntu90percent source diff coverage; Windows real execution does not replace that gate. Actual verification results and independent implementation review remain mandatory before code approval. This slice neither integrates artifacts into public lifecycle consumers nor activates installed Node V2/CI, target Policy/identity or real target application. Existing native V2, complete tests, original five native mutations under a separately current action,85/90 thresholds, same-verifier finalization, Gate and exact-head required remote CI remain unchanged. No new execution action, source authorization, model/WeChat call, private export, repository setting, threshold reduction or historical rewrite is authorized by this review.
